articles.title: Seoni Horror: Hindu Youth Beaten in Public for Walking with Muslim Girl; 6 Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Seoni, Madhya Pradesh – A disturbing incident has come to light in Seoni on Saturday (27 September 2025), where a young Hindu man was brutally assaulted by a group of youths while walking with a Muslim girl near the city bus stand.

body.html:
Seoni, Madhya Pradesh – A disturbing incident has come to light in Seoni on Saturday (27 September 2025), where a young Hindu man was brutally assaulted by a group of youths while walking with a Muslim girl near the city bus stand. The attack, captured on mobile phones, quickly went viral on social media.

According to Seoni Superintendent of Police, the assailants stopped the pair, asked the girl’s name, and upon learning it, targeted the young man, questioning, “Is this Hindu boy your brother?” He was then dragged to the side of the road and beaten severely, while the girl was ordered to move aside.

Following the viral video, police identified seven accused, arrested six, and registered cases under relevant IPC sections. Authorities have assured strict action to maintain law and order.

The incident has raised concerns about communal harmony in the city, prompting police to urge citizens to report any suspicious activity immediately.

articles.title: Jhansi Shocker: Wife Brings ‘Gulabi Gang’ to Assault Husband, Loot House
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh – A shocking case has emerged from Panchavati Colony, where a woman allegedly conspired with her lover and a group claiming to be members of the Gulabi Gang to assault her husband inside his home.

body.html:
Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh – A shocking case has emerged from Panchavati Colony, where a woman allegedly conspired with her lover and a group claiming to be members of the Gulabi Gang to assault her husband inside his home.

According to police, the incident occurred on 18 September around 9 p.m., when the woman, identified as Mohini, arrived with six women and two men, including her lover Pradeep Thakur. Claiming to be from the Gulabi Gang, they forced open the gate and attacked her husband Ghanshyam Sahu and his nephew Rishi Sahu, who were having dinner.

CCTV footage shows the husband being knocked down and beaten for nearly 15 minutes, while Mohini allegedly stood outside and watched. During the assault, three mobile phones and a laptop were stolen. The attackers also threatened to kill him.

Ghanshyam, who married Mohini in 2012 and has two children, alleged that his wife is having an affair with Pradeep and wants to forcibly take the children away. The couple’s dispute is already pending in family court.

Based on Ghanshyam’s complaint and CCTV evidence, police registered a case against 11 accused, including Mohini, Pradeep, and accomplices under relevant IPC sections. Six women and two men are yet to be identified. SHO Rajesh Pal Singh confirmed that the matter is under investigation.

articles.title: BJP Leader’s Son Found Hanging in Sambhal; Suicide Note Blames Wife, In-Laws
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Sambhal: A tragic incident unfolded in the Tanki area where Anshul Varshney (34), son of BJP business cell district coordinator Anil Kumar, was found hanging in his rented home. According to police, Anshul returned from Lucknow on Friday evening.

body.html:
Sambhal: A tragic incident unfolded in the Tanki area where Anshul Varshney (34), son of BJP business cell district coordinator Anil Kumar, was found hanging in his rented home.

According to police, Anshul returned from Lucknow on Friday evening. When his father later arrived, he found the door locked from inside. On breaking it open with neighbours’ help, Anshul was discovered hanging from the ceiling fan. A suicide note was recovered from his pocket.

Family members allege that Anshul was under immense pressure due to a marital dispute. His wife had filed a divorce case and, as per the note, her family was allegedly demanding a house and ₹2 crore for settlement. Anshul wrote that he could no longer bear the harassment and cursed his in-laws in his final words.

The deceased was employed as a computer operator in a Lucknow bank. Married eight years ago, he had a daughter. For the past two and a half years, he was living separately after a dispute with his wife.

Police confirmed that forensic evidence has been collected and the body sent for post-mortem. Further action will follow once the family’s complaint is recorded.

articles.title: Palghar Horror: Mother Beats 7-Year-Old Son to Death with Rolling Pin Over Chicken Demand
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Palghar, Maharashtra – In a shocking case, a 40-year-old woman has been arrested for brutally beating her seven-year-old son to death and attacking her ten-year-old daughter with a rolling pin in Kashipada, Palghar district.

body.html:
Palghar, Maharashtra – In a shocking case, a 40-year-old woman has been arrested for brutally beating her seven-year-old son to death and attacking her ten-year-old daughter with a rolling pin in Kashipada, Palghar district.

Police identified the accused as Pallavi Dhumde, who was living separately from her husband along with her two children and two sisters.

According to investigators, Pallavi’s son Chinmay (7) had asked for chicken at dinner on Friday night. Pallavi, observing Navratri fast, refused. Enraged by his insistence, she repeatedly assaulted him with a rolling pin on the head, chest, back, and face, leading to his death. She also attacked her daughter Lavya (10), who sustained serious injuries.

Despite their condition, Pallavi did not take the children to hospital. A neighbour, alerted by screams, discovered Chinmay lying dead under a sheet. When confronted, Pallavi falsely claimed he had died of jaundice. The neighbour grew suspicious, noticed multiple injury marks, and alerted police.

Police seized the rolling pin used in the assault. An FIR has been registered under Section 103(1) (murder) and other IPC sections. The injured daughter has been admitted to hospital and later shifted to an ashram for care and safety.

District SP Yatish Deshmukh confirmed the arrest and said investigations are ongoing.

articles.title: ‘Insurance Scam Shocker’: Hapur Man Kills Parents, Wife for Crores in Payouts
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hapur Police have uncovered a chilling case where a Meerut man allegedly murdered his parents and wife, staging their deaths as accidents to claim massive insurance amounts.

body.html:
Hapur Police have uncovered a chilling case where a Meerut man allegedly murdered his parents and wife, staging their deaths as accidents to claim massive insurance amounts.

According to police, Vishal Kumar, son of photographer Mukesh Singhal, killed his mother in 2017 and claimed ₹22 lakh insurance. In 2020, his wife died under suspicious circumstances, and he claimed ₹80 lakh. Last year, his father allegedly died in a staged road accident near Garh Ganga, leading Vishal to claim ₹39 crore from multiple insurance companies. While one firm had already released ₹1.5 crore, Niva BUPA flagged irregularities during verification.

Investigations revealed Vishal had taken over 50 insurance policies from companies including Niva BUPA, Tata AIG, Max Life, Tata AIA, Aditya Birla and HDFC Ergo. Despite declaring an annual income of only ₹12–15 lakh, his claims exceeded ₹39 crore.

Discrepancies between Mukesh’s hospital records and post-mortem report raised suspicions, while witnesses admitted being paid to support Vishal’s accident story. The alleged vehicle involved in the crash was never produced. Authorities also found inconsistencies in Aadhar and PAN details.

Police arrested Vishal on Sunday. During interrogation, he confessed to murdering his parents. The death of his wife is also under fresh investigation. Officials further alleged he attempted to bribe an insurance officer to push through a claim.

The case remains under active investigation, with police verifying several other suspicious claims linked to him.

articles.title: CCTV Shocker: Stray Bull Brutally Attacks Elderly Woman in Jodhpur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Jodhpur, Rajasthan – In a horrifying incident, a 60-year-old woman was grievously injured after being attacked by a stray bull in Chainpura Bawdi of Mandore area on Monday, September 22.

body.html:
Jodhpur, Rajasthan – In a horrifying incident, a 60-year-old woman was grievously injured after being attacked by a stray bull in Chainpura Bawdi of Mandore area on Monday, September 22.

The victim, identified as Saroj Gehlot, was walking through a narrow street around 7 AM when the bull suddenly appeared from a turn and charged at her. The bull lifted her with its head and flung her nearly 4 feet away, causing her to collapse against a wall and sustain a serious head injury. She fell unconscious immediately after the impact.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV, showing the deserted lane and the sudden, violent assault. Villagers said that stray cattle have caused repeated accidents in the area, but the Municipal Corporation has failed to take action.

Angry residents are now demanding strict steps from the administration to control the menace of stray animals in rural and urban parts of Jodhpur.
